verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs describe it as an 'incrementally adoptable' framework that builds on standard HTML. Independent users confirm it can be added selectively to templates to 'spruce up' old applications, and that you can just include vue.min.js with no package manager or bundler. One commenter's complaint about build-tool dependency concerns full app builds and does not contradict the drop-in use case. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of mounting components onto existing server-rendered markup (e.g. CDN/script-tag setup, in-DOM templates, multiple mount points), and evidence beyond tagline-level vendor claims.
